unfused_artifact.reason: WFCD lists ~40 distinct Railjack artifact mods that all share the generic pre-identification display name "Unfused Artifact" - the name alone can't tell them apart, so Crossframe can't safely link to any one of them.

orion_and_sirius.name: Sirius & Orion
orion_and_sirius.reason: WFCD's own name field says "Orion & Sirius", but that same record's internal path (SiriusOrion), flavor text, and ability descriptions all consistently say "Sirius & Orion" - matching Overframe's real slug (sirius-orion), reported directly from the live site. Looks like an upstream typo in the name field specifically. The id stays orion_and_sirius (internal only, never shown to users) to avoid rippling a rename through anyone's existing overframe.json entries. The wiki path (/w/Orion) is untouched since nothing suggests it's wrong.
